reason: In packages/core/EventManager.ts:118-119, `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is destructured from `evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` and `.integration` is accessed without optional chaining or a null check. Because `evt.destinationCalendar` can be `null` or empty (packages/types/Calendar.d.ts:171, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1068-1072), `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined` and throws a `TypeError` when `evt.location === MeetLocationType` instead of falling back to Daily.
